grammarFocus: we / they；are；规则复数；my / your / his / her；have / has。
title: My Family Photo
instructions: 这是模拟练习材料，不是官方考试。听录音前先看题。录音会播放两遍。根据录音内容选择或填空。填空题答案必须来自录音原文，且不超过规定词数。所有解释为中文。
transcript:
A: Hi, Lily. Is this a photo of your family?
B: Yes, it is. Look, these are my parents. My mother is a teacher. My father is a doctor.
A: And who is this boy? Is he your brother?
B: Yes, he is. His name is Tom. He is ten years old.
A: You have a big family. Do you have a sister?
B: No, I don't. But we have two dogs. Their names are Coco and Lulu.
A: Two dogs! Are they big?
B: No, they aren't. They are small. Coco is white and Lulu is brown.
A: I see. And your grandparents? Are they in the photo?
B: No, they aren't. They are in Shanghai. We visit them every year.
A: Nice. Thank you, Lily.
B: You're welcome.

questions.explanation: Lily说“these are my parents”，即她的父母。
Lily说“My mother is a teacher.”，所以妈妈是老师。
Lily说“My father is a doctor.”，所以爸爸是医生。
Lily说“He is ten years old.”，所以Tom十岁。
Lily回答“No, I don't.”，说明她没有姐妹。

questions.prompt: Lily家有两只狗。其中一只狗的名字是Coco，另一只狗的名字是______。（填一个词）
questions.explanation: Lily说“Their names are Coco and Lulu.”，所以另一只狗叫Lulu。
questions.evidence: Their names are Coco and Lulu.

questions.prompt: Coco是白色的，Lulu是什么颜色的？______（填一个词）
questions.explanation: Lily说“Coco is white and Lulu is brown.”，所以Lulu是棕色的。
questions.evidence: Coco is white and Lulu is brown.

questions.explanation: Lily说“They are in Shanghai.”，所以爷爷奶奶住在上海。

grammar.title: we / they；are；规则复数；my / your / his / her；have / has
grammar.explanation: 我们用 we 表示“我们”，they 表示“他们/它们”。be 动词用 are，例如 We are students. They are dogs. 名词复数一般加 -s，例如 dog→dogs, parent→parents。my 表示“我的”，your 表示“你的”，his 表示“他的”，her 表示“她的”。have 表示“有”，主语是 he/she/it 时用 has。
grammar.example: We have two dogs. Their names are Coco and Lulu.

questions.explanation: 主语 we 后面用 are。
主语 they 后面用 are。
主语 she 是第三人称单数，用 has。

options: This is my brother. His name is Tom.
This is my brother. Her name is Tom.
This is my brother. Your name is Tom.
answers: This is my brother. His name is Tom.
questions.explanation: Tom 是男孩，所以用 his 表示“他的”。
questions.evidence: This is my brother. His name is Tom.

part1: Do you have a big family?
speaking.part2: Describe a photo of your family. You should say: who is in the photo; what they look like; what they do; and explain why you like this photo.
part3: Do you think family photos are important? Why?
How many people are there in your family?
Do you have a brother or a sister?
What do you do with your family?
